purpose: Recent small-model candidates for EigenSkill-Q fake-quant and chunked C++ audit runs.
selection_rules: Prefer 2024-2026 model families over Qwen2.5-era baselines.
Prefer <=3B parameters for routine 8GB-GPU runs; keep 3-4B models as stress candidates.
Prefer non-gated, transformer-compatible, causal language models.
Treat gated or special-license models as optional probes, not required dependencies.
Do not claim best-in-branch accuracy until the model has completed the same dataset, random-seed, and guard audit.
